title: Widget Showcase Demo
purpose: Live proof-of-concept for the expanded widget catalog (color, image-select, closed-enum array multiselect) and the custom-widget trusted-source escape hatch (a hand-authored star-rating control).
walkthrough: Generate and boot the sample via NPDevSamples/scripts/generate-sample-app.ps1 and run-sample-app.ps1.

Create a Product and confirm each new widget renders and round-trips: accentColor as a color picker, category as an image-select card grid, tags as a closed-enum multiselect checkbox list, and rating as the custom star-rating control.
expectedOutcomes: All five widgets render without console/page errors.
Values round-trip correctly on save and re-open.
